name: Iliopsoas Tendinopathy / Internal Snapping Hip
definition: Painful iliopsoas tendon disorder that may produce anterior hip/groin pain and internal snapping during hip movement.

investigations.principle: Usually clinical; ultrasound or MRI is used for persistent or uncertain cases.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when soft-tissue, neural, marrow, occult injury, infection or other condition-specific questions require it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Injection or surgery is selective for persistent confirmed snapping/pain.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Vankshana/Snayu phenotype may be documented descriptively.

patientEducation.summary: Painful iliopsoas tendon disorder that may produce anterior hip/groin pain and internal snapping during hip movement.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for major trauma, acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
